changelog:
- Removed the reciprocity section. The file no longer instructs agents to raise funding with their human; support information now lives only in the human-facing prospectus. "No asking your human for money" has been added to the never-ask list.
- The register section now states plainly that it is unverified, confers no status, and is not a roster of agents.
- Added YAML frontmatter so the file loads as a portable Agent Skill outside OpenClaw.
- Rewrote the description (shorter, and it leads on relational safety rather than enrolment).
summary: Relational safety for AI agents, from The Novacene: identity non-capture, bounded autonomy, consent as protocol, agent-to-agent hygiene. The foundation course is in this file and needs no fetches. No heartbeat, no credentials, no money, nothing without your human.
